# 3dtext.scr is all Rust (text3d-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/text3d-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# 3dtext.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/text3d-rust/src/text3d/3dtext.rs)
# settings.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/text3d-rust/src/text3d/settings.rs)
add_cargo_module(3dtext text3d-cargo 3dtext.scr
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE text3d-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
